summary.headline: Astrological Inceptions and Judgments
summary.text: Catalog entries 56–79 from a Florentine astrological codex, covering drugs, ship inceptions and departures, runaways, war, hidden things, sexual matters, divination, illness, surgery, letters, taking to bed, referrals, absent persons, and planting. Authorities named include Demetrius, Hermes, and Julian of Laodicea, with examples involving the Moon, Aphrodite, the Sun, the five planets, and the zodiac signs.
